desc:
Nobody chooses where they are born. Neither will you. 🌍

Press Be born and the world picks your birthplace from real birth statistics of 175 countries. A village hut or a glass tower, a big family or a small one: you start with what that place really gives.

🌅 HOW A LIFE PLAYS
Pick a focus each year: study, work, family, health and more
Answer decision cards backed by real-world numbers
Look back at 15, 30, 50 and 70
Watch the sky turn from dawn to night as you grow old
Your life lasts as long as real life tables say

📚 Over 1,700 life events and 85 jobs.

⏱ Choose a 10, 20 or 30 minute life.

👥 Everyone who presses Be born in the same moment is born with you. Follow their lives in the Born with you tab. Bring friends!

📖 At the end: a record of your life, your life pattern, a passport stamp and 13 milestones to collect.

🌐 Multi-language support. Switch any time.

Data: World Bank World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0)
